blunt.li: Wanted to {OLDGOAL} as a kid. Now I want to {GOAL}. Same thing, grown up.

gloomy.li: I wanted to {OLDGOAL} when I was young. Now it's to {GOAL}, and it looks a lot further off.

cold.li: My childhood aim, to {OLDGOAL}, has matured into a more serious one: to {GOAL}.

plain.li: I wanted to {OLDGOAL} so badly when I was younger. I found the old wish today, like a toy in a box, and smiled at it.
I've outgrown wanting to {OLDGOAL}. I don't know what I want instead yet. I'll know it when I see it.

warm.li: I used to want to {OLDGOAL}. It was a good wish for a young person, and I'm glad I had it.

blunt.li: Used to want to {OLDGOAL}. Not anymore. Moving on.

cheerful.li: I've outgrown wanting to {OLDGOAL}! Now I get to pick a brand new dream.

gloomy.li: Once I'd have given anything to {OLDGOAL}. I can't remember now why it mattered so much.

cold.li: My youthful aim, to {OLDGOAL}, no longer applies. I will choose another.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s last wish was to {GOAL}, and {OTHER_pronoun} told me so more than once. We ran out of time.
{OTHER_nameDef} only wanted one more thing: to {GOAL}. I keep thinking we could have helped.
Someone should still {GOAL}, for {OTHER_nameDef}. I think it might have to be me.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL} before the end. I'm sorry we didn't get there together. I'll try to get there for {OTHER_objective}.

blunt.li: {OTHER_nameDef} wanted to {GOAL}. Ran out of time. It's not right.

cheerful.li: {OTHER_nameDef} had one last wish, to {GOAL}. I'm going to see it done, and raise a cup to {OTHER_objective} when I do.

gloomy.li: {OTHER_nameDef} died still wishing to {GOAL}. I keep thinking of all the days we spent on other things.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef}'s last wish, to {GOAL}, went unmet. It remains possible for someone else.

plain.li: [story:Suitors,stage:0] {OTHER_nameDef} laughed at my joke, did you see?
[story:Suitors,stage:0] I've run out of reasons to walk past {OTHER_nameDef}'s workbench.
[story:Suitors,stage:1] {THIRD_nameDef} again, carrying {OTHER_nameDef}'s basket.
[story:Suitors,stage:2] Whatever {OTHER_nameDef} decides, I'll shake {THIRD_nameDef}'s hand.
[story:TwoStudents] Two students and only one of me.
[story:TwoStudents,stage:2] Those two are going to have to sort it out themselves.
[story:TwoStudents,stage:3] {OTHER_nameDef} and {THIRD_nameDef} are helping each other now.
[story:Siblings] If those two could just get through one meal.
[story:Siblings,stage:2] Three days and not a cross word between my children.
[story:Between] I'm not taking sides, I've told them both.
[story:Between,stage:2] No more messages, they can talk to each other.
[story:RoadCalls] The camp's fire was lit again last night.
[story:RoadCalls,stage:1] There's a bag under my bed I keep looking at.
[story:WeightOfOffice] Being {NAME} is harder than it looks.
[story:WeightOfOffice,stage:2] I made the call, and I'd make it again.
[story:FarNews] Any news from the road about {FACTION}?
[story:FarNews,stage:1] I wonder if {LOST} got my letter.
[story:BadNights] I don't like the dark much.
[story:BadNights,stage:1] I've got a light by my bed now.
[story:NotAChild] I'm not a child, whatever anyone says.
[story:NotAChild,stage:1] Look at this, and tell me it's not good work.
[story:NewParent] Has anyone seen my sleep, because I had some once?
[story:NewParent,stage:2] {NAME} slept four whole hours last night.
[story:OneMoreSpring] My knees know the weather better than I do.
[story:OneMoreSpring,stage:2] One more good piece of work, while my hands still listen.
[story:OneMoreSpring,stage:3] Pull up a seat, the sun's warm here.
[story:LastTwo] {OTHER_nameDef} is in my chair again.
[story:LastTwo,stage:2] {OTHER_nameDef} remembers the first winter all wrong, but remembers it.
[quirk:Proverbs] Many hands make light work, so yes to "{AMBITION}".
[quirk:Proverbs] A tree is best planted twenty years ago, and second best today.
[quirk:Volunteers] Put me down for the first shift of "{AMBITION}", whatever it is.
[quirk:KeepsRecords] I'll keep the tally for "{AMBITION}", since someone has to.
[quirk:Worrier] Yes, as long as someone checks it twice, and I'll check it three times.
[quirk:Proverbs] Don't build the barn before you've bought the cow.
[quirk:Proverbs] Measure twice, cut once, and we haven't measured even once.
[quirk:KeepsRecords] I wrote down the last three plans like this, if you'd like to hear how they ended.
[quirk:Worrier] What if it rains, or we're raided halfway through, or the whole thing falls down?
[quirk:WrongLaugh] Sorry, I'm not laughing at the idea, only at how much work it is.
[quirk:Proverbs] A hungry belly has no ears, so food first and "{WISH}" after.
[quirk:KeepsRecords] By my notes this is the third thing {OTHER_nameDef} has asked for this season.
[quirk:Worrier] What happens if we give {OTHER_nameDef} "{WISH}" and then the winter's a hard one?
[quirk:Proverbs] A good day. Make hay while the sun shines, my mother said, and today the sun shone.
[quirk:KeepsRecords] Good day. Noted in the book: weather fair, eggs eleven, nobody shouted.
[quirk:Storyteller] The children made me tell the one about the bear twice tonight. I added a second bear.
[quirk:SoftSpot] My stray ate out of my hand today. It's taken all season.
[quirk:Volunteers] I volunteered for the worst job of the day and finished it before lunch. Felt grand.
[quirk:Proverbs] Bad night. Things look better in the morning, they say, so I'm waiting on the morning.
[quirk:Worrier] Lay awake sure something terrible would happen. Nothing did. I'm exhausted anyway.
[quirk:NightLight] My light went out in the night and I woke up in the dark and didn't sleep again.
[quirk:WrongLaugh] {OTHER_nameDef} teased me and I laughed, which only made {OTHER_objective} do it more. I wasn't laughing inside.
[quirk:Proverbs] {OTHER_nameDef} made fun of my sayings again. He who laughs last, I said. That didn't help.
